name: Neostigmine
mechanism: Reversibly inhibits acetylcholinesterase enzyme, increasing acetylcholine at neuromuscular junction to overcome competitive blockade from non-depolarizing muscle relaxants
dosing: Reversal of neuromuscular blockade: 2.5-5 mg IV (usual max 5 mg, 0.07 mg/kg) given with anticholinergic (glycopyrronium 0.5-1 mg or atropine 1.2-2.4 mg) to prevent muscarinic side effects. Give only after some recovery (presence of twitch response on train-of-four monitoring). Myasthenia gravis: oral 15-30 mg initially, maintenance 75-300 mg daily in divided doses
contraindications: Bowel or urinary tract obstruction, recent bowel anastomosis, peritonitis, asthma (may cause bronchospasm)
interactions: Aminoglycosides and other drugs with neuromuscular blocking effects may reduce efficacy. Anticholinergics (atropine, glycopyrronium) given together to counteract muscarinic effects. Depolarizing muscle relaxants (succinylcholine) - interaction complex
monitoring: Train-of-four monitoring for adequate reversal (4/4 twitches with sustained response), respiratory adequacy, heart rate, blood pressure, signs of cholinergic excess (bradycardia, hypersalivation, bronchospasm)
pregnancy: Use when benefits outweigh risks; used in obstetric anaesthesia when needed
sideEffects: Muscarinic effects: bradycardia, hypersalivation, bronchospasm, nausea, abdominal cramps, increased bowel motility, miosis, blurred vision. Nicotinic effects at high doses: muscle fasciculation, weakness
pharmacokinetics: Onset IV: 7-10 minutes; peak effect 10-20 minutes; duration 30-60 minutes; eliminated renally (adjust in renal impairment)
clinicalPearls: ALWAYS co-administer with anticholinergic (glycopyrronium preferred - better cardiac profile than atropine). Only use when some neuromuscular recovery present (not for deep block - use sugammadex for rocuronium/vecuronium instead). Does NOT reverse depolarizing blockade (succinylcholine). Cheaper than sugammadex but slower reversal. Required for reversal of atracurium, cisatracurium, mivacurium. Monitor for recurarisation - may need extended recovery monitoring.
indication: Reversal of non-depolarizing neuromuscular blockade (atracurium, cisatracurium, pancuronium, vecuronium), myasthenia gravis treatment
